pages.title: Советы к концу измерения
pages.text: This chapter covers some tips and or tricks for rounding out this simulation.

pages.title: Selective Quarrying
pages.notes: As mentioned in the $(l:sim_2/__late_dimension_tips#quarry)End of Dimension Tips of the last chapter$(), the quarry card in a builder help you acquire resources quickly.$(br2)$(br2)Moving the quarry to another simulation, for example the $(item)Lunar Plane$(), and whitelisting only $(item)Aquamarine Shale$() in the filter will prove extremely useful.

pages.title: Balancing Automations
pages.text: Automations that run without stop can quickly drain all your resources. Sometimes that is not desirable.$(br2)The $(item)Level Emitter$() lets you emit a redstone signal when you are above/under a certain level in your AE2 network.

pages.title: Balancing Automations
pages.text: For example, you could have a $(item)Fluid Transposer$() that only runs when it receives a high redstone signal.$(br2)Then you place a $(item)Level Emitter$() pointing towards the $(item)Fluid Transposer$(), only emitting a redstone signal if you have less than 3000 $(item)Wet Clay$() in your AE2 network.
